title: CLCON/117/2006 of JAGDISH CHANDRA BELWAL Vs DR. S.S SANDHU

paras.text:
Civil Contempt No. 117/2006
Hon'ble J.C.S. Rawat, J.
 This Contempt Petition has
been filed under the Contempt of
Court's Act to punish the contemnors
for not complying the order dated
09.12.2005 passed by this court in
Writ Petition No. 277/2005 (S/B in
which the court has directed the
respondent to consider and dispose of
Annexure 1 representation dated
15.01.2004 of the petitioner, if it was
received and is pending, as
expeditiously as possible and at any
rate, within a period of two months
from the production of a copy of this
judgment. In pursuance of the said
order, the contemnor had filed the
supplementary counter affidavit
stating therein that the order of the
High Court has been complied with.
Learned counsel for the petitioner also
agreed that the order has been
complied with. As the compliance of
the order of the court has been made,
the petition is rendered infructuous.
 Accordingly, the contempt
petition is dismissed as infructuous.
 The notice issued to the
contemnor is hereby discharged.
